versions.subject: Suspicious mshta patterns
versions.detection:
# Binary Selector
selection_base:
    Image|endswith: '\mhsta.exe'
# Suspicious parents
selection1:
    ParentImage|endswith:
        - '\cmd.exe'
        - '\powershell.exe'
# Suspicious folders
selection2:
    CommandLine|contains: 
        - '\AppData\Local'
        - 'C:\Windows\Temp'
        - 'C:\Users\Public' 
# Suspicious Execution Locations
filter3:
    Image|contains:
        - 'C:\Windows\System32'
        - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64'
# Suspicious extensions
filter4:
    CommandLine|contains: 
        - '.htm'
        - '.hta'
    CommandLine|endswith: 
        - 'mshta.exe'
        - 'mshta'
condition: selection_base and ( selection1 or selection2 ) or ( selection_base and not filter3 ) or ( selection_base and not filter4 )
versions.spl: (Image="*\\mhsta.exe" ParentImage IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\powershell.exe") OR CommandLine IN ("*\\AppData\\Local*", "*C:\\Windows\\Temp*", "*C:\\Users\\Public*")) OR (Image="*\\mhsta.exe" NOT (Image IN ("*C:\\Windows\\System32*", "*C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64*"))) OR (Image="*\\mhsta.exe" NOT (CommandLine IN ("*.htm*", "*.hta*") CommandLine IN ("*mshta.exe", "*mshta")))
